title: Share My Burdens, Lord * /
firstLine: Dear Lord, I pray that Thou wilt help me bear my heavy load;

lines: Dear Lord, I pray that Thou wilt help me bear my heavy load;
Please share it with me, precious Lord,
For in this world I know I need a thorn within my side.
On Thee, my God, I will depend,
If in this life I had no care to burden me each day,
I may not long for heaven's home
As I pass by this way.
So, my dear God, I do not askthat I be burden free;
Just hold my hand in thine, dear Lord,
and lead me home to Thee.
